pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, roughly polygonal patches with softened, low-contrast edge gradients; patch size is variable across the visible mid-flank and lower neck regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Latticed network of light-toned pathways forming distinct nodal intersections; pathways exhibit a diffuse appearance with poorly defined boundaries due to image resolution and motion blur.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents as a continuous, blurred dark silhouette along the neck-to-shoulder transition; individual hair-level serrations are not resolvable due to motion artifact.
